notes.title: Moving Out 2 | Pre Orders Now Live
notes.content:
You've seen that we've scheduled our moving date and you've chosen your favourite F.A.R.T, so probably think you are now all set to Move Out now? WRONG! We've one last thing for your checklist...

[h2]PRE-ORDERING MOVING OUT 2![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/c5dec40175fdb159950ef1c9a987e5cd7a949a29.jpg[/img]
Moving Out 2 is now available to Pre-Order so you can finally get ready for our August 15th launch date! We've different options available for pre-order available so you can get the right version for you!

[b]Here we are going to unpack what comes in each version available to pre-order
[/b]
[h2]Standard edition[/h2]
Moving Out 2 base game.
 
[h2]Moving Out 1+2 bundle[/h2]
The ultimate Moving Out experience - a copy of both Moving Out 1 & 2 base games in one neat bundle! (This will become available on launch - August 15th)

[h2]Digital Deluxe Edition (PC Exclusive)[/h2] 
There's no better way to move than with the Digital Deluxe Edition of Moving Out 2. 
Includes:[list]
[*] Moving Out 2 base game
[*] The Art & Design of Moving Out 2: A 250+ page digital art book
[*] Jumbo Super Silly Activity Book: A digital kids activity book
[*] Behind the Scenes Commentary: Over 4 hrs of behind-the-scenes commentary on the making of Moving Out 2 from SMG, Brad Gentle the composer and Sub Zero the sound design team
[*] 3D Printable Models: Print your own movers
[*] Soundtrack: 24 Original Tracks composed for the game[/list]
[h2]F.A.R.Tastic Four DLC Pre-order Bonus[/h2]

Every pre-order of either the Standard or Digital Deluxe versions of the game comes with [b]The F.A.R.Tastic Four Pack[/b], a pack of 4 additional movers for Moving Out 2 absolutely free as a little thank you for your eagerness to move out!

[h2]Unpack our Pre Order Trailer now![/h2]

Once pre-ordered, you'll be ready to move into Packmore and its surrounding dimensions ready for launch day! 📦

notes.title: Moving Out is the latest game in the SMG Game Universe
notes.content:
So we just launched a new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/996770/Moving_Out/]Moving Out[/url] and it's nothing like OTTTD however... it's still in the same universe.

WHAT! How? I hear you typing on the mechanical keyboard.

Ominicorp originally started as Smooth Moves in Packmore in 1982 and through aggressive M&A become Ominicorp some 100 years later. The bot testing in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/471810/Death_Squared/]Death Squared[/url] lead to military contracts, that lead to them eventually starting private military arm which was OTTTD.

This is why the game features the voice talents of [url=https://twitter.com/RicepirateMick]Mick Lauer.[/url] He's the "boss" of Smooth Moves and his great, great, great, great, great, great, great, great, great, grandson is Dave. The family didn't want to give him any special treatment so left him as a level 1 testing technician. The limited gene pool of the human race by the time OTTTD came around meant that the entire Omnicorp army was related and again all voiced by Mick.

Check out the trailer below, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/996770/Moving_Out/]Moving Out[/url] and help kickstart the economy again by giving us some of your hard earned money.

[previewyoutube=Bmq2NmJ5XB0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Nintendo Switch release & upcoming updates to Steam
notes.content:
We've just released OTTTD on the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/otttd-over-the-top-tower-defense-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]. 

So now you can buy the game again and play on the go. 
Or just recommend it to a friend who missed out in 2014! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6274116/46261aba2dfa32857f7de4ec6732d31d51e5737c.png[/img]

We'll also be doing a small update here on Steam to match some of the features added for the Switch. Hoping to have this done this week.

FFWD: You can now speed up the action!!
EASY & MEDIUM DIFFICULTY: For those that just want to enjoy the ride

We're all heads down on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/996770/Moving_Out/]Moving Out[/url] and No Way Home right now but wanted to say thanks for the support. Anyone who bought OTTTD are true OG fans!

cheers
Ash@SMG

notes.title: 2014 Intel Level Up Game Developer Contest Winners Announced
notes.content:
Intel® today announced the nine winning teams for the 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest, each being offered worldwide distribution via Steam!

The 2014 Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest asks game developers to submit their playable proofs of concept, alphas, betas, and unreleased demos for a chance to win cash prizes and ultimately be distributed via Steam. The categories, winners, and links to where you can find the games on Steam, can be found on the 2014 Intel® Level Up Contest Hall of Fame.

You can read full details of the contest over on the official Intel® Level Up Game Developer Contest.

notes.title: Update 1.24 is here! Fixes, fixes and additions!
notes.content:
Hello HEROCORP employees!

Thanks to everyone who has been playing since the launch on Steam - we've received a tonne of feedback, and we want you to know that here at HEROCORP, we value your contribution. It's been a tad busy around here, but we're getting into ship shape with out first official update! 

We've added an option for left or right click to move heroes, tweaked the hot key system, added some visual feedback, and fixed up those pesky achievements. If you still have some issues, please report them in the bug thread on the community hub.

We'll see you on the battlefield! 
Steve

[h1] 12/08/14

[list]
[*]Option for left click or right click to move heroes (right click is default)
[*]Function keys to select units - F1, F2, F3 to select heroes during a misison (tab key removed)
[*]Added cursor display for invalid movement locations
[*]Ground texture fix - Ground textures should no longer disappear when alt+tabbing in/out of the game
[*]All Stars achievement fixed - Was not triggering
[*]Only Rocket Towers achievement fixed - Was not triggering
[*]Million Coins achievement fixed - Was not persisting through plays
[*]9001 Enemies achievement fixed - Was not persisting through plays
[*]fixed a bug in repair wave and certain other skills that would cause the fx to stick
